name: loop_failure_handler
description: failureWorkflow for loop_engine: runs automatically if the engine itself fails (timeout, unrecoverable task error). Records the failed run's id, reason, and failed task for triage. Extension point: append HTTP / event / notification tasks here to page an operator or open a ticket.

inputParameters.expression: (function(){ return { failed_workflow_id: ''+($.wfId||''), reason: ''+($.reason||''), failure_status: ''+($.failureStatus||''), failed_task_id: ''+($.failureTaskId||''), note: 'loop_engine run failed outside its own decision policy; inspect the failed workflow execution for the decision_log up to the failure.' }; })();
